articleTitle: The effect of empagliflozin on inflammation and oxidative stress in patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention, a randomized controlled trial.
takeaways: Empagliflozin 10mg taken for just 3 days significantly reduced cystatin C levels (a kidney function and cardiovascular risk marker) and pro-oxidant-antioxidant balance scores in patients undergoing heart procedures
Short-term empagliflozin treatment showed measurable anti-inflammatory effects within 72 hours, with C-reactive protein reductions becoming statistically significant after adjusting for other factors
The cardioprotective benefits of empagliflozin appear to work rapidly through reducing oxidative stress and inflammation, not just through long-term blood sugar control
In a study of 121 cardiovascular patients (53% male), empagliflozin demonstrated safety and efficacy for short-term use during percutaneous coronary intervention procedures
